hero.description: I build fast, reliable interfaces for complex web products — Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, reusable component systems, and frontend architecture that stays maintainable as the product grows.
hero.experience: 4+ years shipping production Vue applications end to end, including independent delivery, Vue 2→3 migrations, and AI-assisted workflows with a clear review bar.

Shipped flows for repair intake, service tracking, customer records, work statuses, and operational tasks.
Delivered the API layer with AI-assisted development while owning review quality for production.
Added Google integration and CI/CD for smoother delivery and operations.
Designed reusable UI patterns for forms, tables, and operational screens used daily by staff.
Owned frontend architecture and implementation independently, from initial structure to production.
quardex: Designed and maintained scalable frontend architecture across multi-module product UIs.
Built a reusable component system shared across multiple product modules.
Integrated Chart.js and AmCharts for data visualization in product views.
Improved UI performance, responsiveness, and code-review quality on key pages.
nsoc360: Developed UI for a monitoring and analytics product used by an EU client.
Worked in a Vue 2 and Vue 3 hybrid architecture and contributed to migration paths.
Implemented and optimized state management with Vuex and Pinia.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in an agile remote setup.
nda: Built the frontend from scratch, including architecture and a reusable component system.
Developed custom form components and validation logic for complex product flows.
Worked closely with the product team to define UI and UX.
